items.q: But the music was great and Gordon was usually playing drums. Gordon Smith. And the first time I heard Gordon, oh man, it wasn't there. The first time I heard him was at another gig with Vic Circh.

ctx.x: Gordon Smith, yeah. He was about — he passed away young like 27 or something.
